title: Vendor contract renewal
turns: Okay, I think everyone's here. Let's talk about the hosting contract, it renews at the end of the month.
Hi, this is Dana from finance. The vendor sent the new quote yesterday. It's twelve percent higher than last year.
Twelve percent is a lot. Our usage actually went down after we moved the logs to cold storage.
So we have some room to push back.
I'd say so. I can pull the usage numbers for the last six months and send them over.
That would help. If we can show lower usage, I'd ask for a flat renewal.
Then we sign for one year only, not three, and look at other vendors in the spring.
I'm fine with that. Moving would take about two months of engineering time, so one year gives us room.
Alright. We ask for a flat renewal, and if they refuse, we sign for one year. Dana, you'll run the negotiation?
Yes, I'll call their account manager on Monday.
Great. Usage numbers by Friday then, and Dana calls them Monday. Thanks.
decisions: Ask the vendor for a flat renewal
If the vendor refuses, sign for one year instead of three and review other vendors in the spring
